slots.title: Portrait de capitaine
slots.themeBrief: Portrait fidèle V2, nouveau lieu et nouvelle pose.

slots.poseEnglish: Full-body three-quarter stance with weight on right leg, RIGHT-hand narrow cyan rapier angled down inside the frame, LEFT-hand brass pistol drawn back near the chest, gaze toward the bridge.

slots.poseEnglish: Dynamic long fencing lunge to image right, both complete boots visible, RIGHT-hand rapier extended at a diagonal safely within the frame and LEFT-hand pistol drawn down near hip; narrow cyan aether currents coil around brass mooring anchors as a speculative Nexus ability.

slots.title: Route libérée
slots.themeBrief: Victoire calme, sans cible blessée ni pose de portrait reprise.
slots.themeSource: Elara individual V2 visual + originalUniversesManifest AetherCrown lore; imposed fifteen-slot CG matrix; CG07 adaptation authored in this plan

slots.poseEnglish: Relaxed upright seated victory on a brass cargo crate, one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, slight confident smile; RIGHT-hand rapier lowered beside the crate and LEFT-hand pistol resting safely across thigh with muzzle away from body.

slots.poseEnglish: Exhausted seated defeat on the floor against a cold boiler, both legs extended fully inside frame, slumped shoulders and bowed head; RIGHT hand loosely holds rapier near floor while pistol rests on the floor at her anatomicalLEFT, no wounds.

slots.title: Monopole de la capitaine
slots.themeBrief: What If : l’ouvreuse de routes impose le monopole de l’air.
slots.themeSource: Elara individual V2 visual + originalUniversesManifest AetherCrown lore; imposed fifteen-slot CG matrix; CG12 adaptation authored in this plan
slots.poseBrief: Debout très droite au garde-à-vous, pieds rapprochés ; rapière droite verticale devant elle et pistolet gauche abaissé, visage fermé, costume devenu uniforme rigide bordeaux/noir/or.
slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF alignment reversal, unmistakably speculative: authoritarian Elara stands rigidly at attention with feet together, RIGHT-hand rapier vertical before her and LEFT-hand pistol lowered. Same V2 identity, a rigid burgundy/black/gold uniform variation, stern expression; chained air valves and identical sealed access gates visibly invert her freedom-of-routes role. No real-world insignia.

slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF male counterpart of Elara, clearly masculine facial jaw/brow and shoulders without changing skin, dark-brown wavy high updo, V2 burgundy/gold costume or anatomical weapon sides. Lean forward over a railing with one complete boot on a low crate; RIGHT-hand rapier near hip, LEFT-hand pistol angled away. White blouse front closed naturally; no invented current age.

slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF non-graphic ether-corrupted Elara floats a few inches above floor with one knee bent, head tilted and arms angled down/out; visibly cool grey skin and pale cyan eyes with small luminous non-injury marks. Keep V2 brown updo, burgundy/gold coat and the thin RIGHT-hand rapier / LEFT-hand brass pistol intact, no gore or body damage.

slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF experienced future: visibly silver-grey temples and a few grey strands in the same brown wavy high updo, subtle facial age lines, faithful burgundy coat with repaired gold seams. Sit sideways on a navigation bench with one boot on a low footrest, both hands unfolding a plain map; exact original rapier and pistol set aside nearby. No assertion of her current age.
